evidence.summary: Reuters and AP report Saudi Civil Defence issued hostile-aerial-threat warnings for Riyadh and Al-Kharj, with booms heard and flames/black smoke visible near King Khalid International Airport. The all-clear followed. Cause, weapon, precise impact point, BDA and casualties were not established in the reporting horizon. Do not automatically code the visible fire as a successful Houthi strike absent Saudi/independent attribution.

Reuters reports the Washington Post, citing five unidentified officials, counted at least 22 U.S. military fatalities during the Iran-war period, four above the Pentagon public figure of 18. Some additional deaths may not be directly combat-related. Defense Secretary Hegseth called the report false. Preserve 18 as the official public count and 22 as a sourced competing period-fatality count until identities, circumstances and combat attribution are reconciled.
unresolved: Identities and dates of four additional deaths

evidence.summary: Reuters reports Iran executed Hossein Pedaran after the judiciary said he was convicted of spying for Mossad and supplying information on missile sites in Isfahan province. Preserve the execution as an Iranian judicially announced event; preserve the underlying espionage conduct and claimed motive as state allegations/conviction findings rather than independently verified intelligence facts.

Reuters reports UNIFIL leadership is planning transfer of responsibilities before the mission's scheduled end-of-2026 withdrawal, while coordination with the Lebanese army and UN agencies continues. Israeli forces remain in positions in southern Lebanon and Hezbollah-disarmament efforts remain stalled. This updates the Lebanon security architecture drawer but does not establish a replacement mission or successful disarmament.

Reuters reports Israeli strikes killed at least three Palestinians in Gaza on Sep. 19. Israel said targets included militants; Palestinian health officials supplied casualty reporting. Preserve individual target/status claims separately from confirmed deaths where identities and militant status remain contested.

AP reports U.S. Central Command said successful oil shipments had moved through Hormuz despite Iran's blockade. No in-window primary commercial transit dataset newer than Reuters/Kpler's Thursday count was surfaced. Preserve CENTCOM's statement as evidence that some passage continues, not as evidence of normalized or unrestricted traffic.
unresolved: Number, identity, timing and escort status of shipments
